caption: The drawing depicts a rounded rectangular tin or box with a teal green background. The front surface features an ornate architectural structure resembling a small round gazebo with columns and a dome, sitting on a patch of land surrounded by flowers and foliage in colors of white, red, yellow, and green. Beside the structure is a tall, narrow, striped column, and a bird in mid-flight, colored in shades of brown and cream, is seen to the left. The scene also includes several stylized trees with dark green foliage and red accents, as well as patches of yellow flowers scattered in the landscape. On the top surface of the box, a large tree with a twisting, leafless trunk spreads to the right, and a brown and cream duck or bird is lying down to the left side, with hints of rolling hills or landscape in the background. The colors used are predominantly teal, green, brown, cream, white, yellow, and red, and the entire composition is viewed from an angle so that the front and top surfaces of the box are visible against a plain, neutral background.
title: Bandbox
